about_the_game:
Cat Summoner and Block Puzzle is a 2D puzzle adventure game on PC. A summoner girl and her fellow cats try to revive the withered land.

Story

Sylvarant is a dying world.
On it are a land of Blight, a land of Drought, and a land of Tempests. At the center of these three regions is 'the land of Forests'.
The world of which these four lands comprise is dying.

The residents of the three exterior regions abandoned their homelands, which have become uninhabitable, and moved to the land of Forests.
But even there, the greenery is gradually disappearing.

Amidst this crisis, a young girl rises to the occasion.
Her name is Airi Tex.

A cat summoner, she heads for the floating ruins in the sky to revive the green land she saw in a picture book when she was a child.
Together with her partner, Fuyu, a summoned cat, she works to solve puzzles in the ruins, collect energy, and revive the earth.

Game Rules

▲[1] Control the main character, Airi, and move the ice blocks onto all of the switches to clear the stage.

▲[2] Ice sculptures with numbers on them can be pushed up, down, left or right. Once moved, ice sculptures will not stop until they hit an obstacle.

▲[3] Summoning a cat like Fuyu will cause the floating floors A to C to fall.
